verses.1: And Moses took care of the sheep belonging to his priest, Midian. He led those sheep beyond the desert, and they came to Mount Sinai.
verses.2: And the angel of the LORD saw him in a flame that was inside the furnace. He saw that the furnace was filled with fire, and the flames could not be extinguished.
verses.3: And Moses said, “Please, let me see this great sight. I don’t want to die.”
verses.4: And Jehovah saw that it was time to act. He called out to Moses from within the smoke. Moses said, “Here I am.”
verses.5: And he said, “Do not bring your shoes onto your feet. For the place where you stand is holy ground.”
verses.6: And he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face because he was afraid of looking at the God.
verses.7: And the LORD said, “I have seen the poor people of my people who are in Egypt. I have heard their cries from their sides. For I know their suffering.”
verses.8: And he was brought down from Egypt to save him. He was taken out of that land and brought to a good and spacious land, a land full of milk and vegetables. To a place where the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivvites, and Jebusites lived.
verses.9: And now, behold, the cries of the children of Israel come to me. And I also see the pressure that comes from Egypt upon them.
verses.10: And now, I will send you to Pharaoh. I will bring out my people, the children of Israel, from Egypt.
verses.11: And Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”
verses.12: And he said, “If I remain with you, then this is what you will do: I have sent you to bring the people out of Egypt. You shall serve God on that mountain.”
verses.13: And Moses said to God, “Here I am. I have come to the children of Israel. I said to them, ‘The gods of your ancestors sent me to you.’ But they asked me, ‘What is your name? What did you say to them?’”
verses.14: And God said to Moses, “What shall it be?” Moses replied, “Say to the children of Israel, ‘I will send an angel before you.’”
verses.15: And God said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel: ‘The LORD, your God, is the same God who was with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I have sent you to tell them this: This is my name forever; it will be a reminder of me for generations to come.’”
verses.16: Go and gather together the elders of Israel. Say to them, “The LORD, your God, appears to me. I am the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Then say, “I have punished you and all those who were done evil in Egypt.”
verses.17: And he said, “I will bring you out of Egypt into the land of Canaan. I will take you to the land of Hittite, Amorite, Perizzite, Hivvite, and Jebusite. I will lead you to the land where there is milk and honey.”
verses.18: And they heard your call. You came, along with the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt. They said to him, “The LORD, the God of the Israelites, has brought destruction upon us. Now let us go through the desert for three days, so that we may worship the LORD our God.”
verses.19: And I know that the king of Egypt will not allow you to go away, and he certainly won’t give you strength to do so.
verses.20: And I will send my hand, and I will destroy Egypt with all its glory. After that, I will send you away.
verses.21: And I will give the grace of this people to the Egyptians. But if you go there, you will not be able to leave.
verses.22: And a woman asked from her house and from her home for things of gold and silver, and for clothes. They put them on their children and their daughters. And they were saved from Egypt.
